intro: The Marshall Islands are two chains of low coral atolls, averaging about 2 m above sea level.

chapters.title: Atolls
text: Kwajalein has one of the largest lagoons in the world. Bikini Atoll is a World Heritage site for its nuclear history and sunken warships.

chapters.title: Rising seas
text: Rising seas threaten homes and fresh water.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Marshall Islands' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
